subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Hostile
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Hostile"** means unfriendly, antagonistic, or showing ill will. (शत्रुतापूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example:** The negotiations were difficult due to the hostile attitude of the other party.
 
 
 
• **"Friendly"** refers to being kind, pleasant, and supportive. (मित्रवत)
 
 
• **Example:** She has a friendly demeanor that makes everyone feel welcome.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Hostile'** is **'Friendly'**.
